simple.summary: הֲרִיסָה (hărîyçâh) means something demolished First listed occurrence: Amos 9 11.

definitions.full: H2034. hariycah [ הֲרִיסָה ] noun feminine ruin (concrete); — אָקִים וַהֲרִסֹתָיו Amos 9:11 and its ruins (i.e. of דָּוִיד סֻכַּת ) will I raise up (|| מִּרְצֵיהֶן ).
